Container.Name: Courmap Proxy
Container.Overview:
Courmap Proxy sits between your indexers (usually through Prowlarr) and Sonarr. It recognizes anime release names and rewrites the ones it is sure about, so Sonarr imports each release as the right episode. Releases it is unsure about pass through unchanged.
Setup guide: https://courmap.com/getting-started/sonarr/

Config.Name: Status page port
Config.Description: The proxy's status page, and the address Sonarr uses to reach each indexer (for example http://courmap-proxy:9797/tracker).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Downloaded Courmap data and the unresolved release log. If the status page says the data folder is not writable, run chown -R 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/courmap-proxy in the Unraid terminal.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Optional courmap-proxy.yaml with the same settings as the variables below. Environment variables win over it.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Address of your Sonarr. Without it and the API key, every release passes through unchanged. Use the host's IP address if the containers are not on one network.

Config.Name: Sonarr API key
Config.Description: Your Sonarr API key (Sonarr, Settings, General). The proxy uses it to read your series list.

Config.Name: Indexer URL
Config.Description: One upstream Torznab or Newznab feed, usually a Prowlarr indexer such as http://prowlarr:9696/1/api (the number is the indexer's ID in Prowlarr). The name between INDEXER_ and _URL is a label you choose: TRACKER is served at /tracker, lowercase, with underscores turned into hyphens. Add more indexers as extra variables, for example INDEXER_NYAA_URL.

Config.Name: Indexer type
Config.Description: Leave blank for torrents. Set to newznab for a usenet indexer. When blank, the proxy detects the type from the feed's first results. Change TRACKER to match the label of the indexer above.

Config.Name: Sonarr refresh minutes
Config.Description: How often the Sonarr series list is reloaded.

Config.Name: Data refresh hours
Config.Description: How often the Courmap data release is checked. A new dump is downloaded only when the data version changes.

Config.Name: Upstream cache seconds
Config.Description: Identical queries to an indexer within this time share one request. 0 turns the cache off.
